evidence: The Company and its third-party vendors may develop or incorporate artificial intelligence technology into certain business processes, services or products.

The use of artificial intelligence presents several risks, including an uncertain and evolving legal and regulatory environment, along with the reliability of information generated and the complexity and rapid pace of change in artificial intelligence models.
If the Bank were to falter in any of these areas, it could have an adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
ai_positioning.summary: La société est prudente quant à l'utilisation de l'IA en raison des risques associés, notamment l'évolution réglementaire et la fiabilité des informations générées.
